The Claude mascot

Living documentation for app/components/claude/mascot.vue. The markup, the CSS, the state rules, the timings, the sizes and the colour tokens on this page are all read out of the source when it is generated, so nothing here can describe a mascot that is not the one shipped.

Regenerate with node --experimental-strip-types tools/mascot-states.ts.

The mark is Anthropic's. The hat, lens, monitor, keyboard and cloud are drawn for this app in the mark's own rect language.

What decides the state

A latching machine over the turn, not a lookup on the newest call.

  • thinking whenever nothing else is detected: the gap between your message and the first block back, and any block naming no tool.
  • investigating on Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, WebFetch, WebSearch, ToolSearch, Skill.
  • coding on Write, Edit, NotebookEdit. It latches: after a write, reads stay coding for the rest of the turn.
  • running on Agent, Task, Workflow, anything matching mcp__*, and shell still going after 6000ms.
  • idle when there is no open turn at all.

The five states

Teleporting between perches

No single mascot moves. Each row owns one, and the leave finishes before the enter begins, so the pair reads as one that travelled. Leave opacity 300ms ease-in 850ms, scale 400ms ease-in 850ms, translate 400ms ease-in 850ms, enter opacity 300ms var(--ease-out, ease-out) 900ms, scale 400ms var(--ease-out, ease-out) 900ms, translate 400ms var(--ease-out, ease-out) 900ms, both from opacity: 0; scale: 0.18; translate: 0 12%;. The demo applies the same classes Vue applies in the app.

beat row · Claude's turn
chat input · your turn

The portal opens, Claude looks it over for half a second, steps through, and half a second later both portals shut. The whole hand-over is 2100ms; the portal runs portal 2100ms var(--ease-out, ease-out).

Idle repertoire

The legs never move when idle. One move is picked at random, held 900ms, then it rests before the next.
